title: Derangement Counting Formula
recommendation: Prime target. Finite, constructive, excellent Mathlib fit. Recurrence relation may be easier path than full inclusion-exclusion.
notes: Inclusion-exclusion is partially in Mathlib; may need to extend
Recurrence D(n) = (n-1)·(D(n-1) + D(n-2)) is alternative proof path
Small-case computational verification (n ≤ 10) is easy warmup
